Name: Lynnea's recolor of Bog's forest UI interface
Author: Lynneaura
Description:
[size=3]This is my purple recolor of [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23987?_gl=1*12p3bov*_ga*NzM2MjI3MTguMTcxMTE5MjI4Ng..*_ga_N0TELNQ37M*MTcxNTg4NzkwNy4xMjYuMS4xNzE1ODg4MzYxLjAuMC4w]Bog's Forest UI Interface[/url]. [b]I do have their permission to post this. <3[/b]

Please go check out their original mods! They are truly amazing for all the swamp witches out there who like a magical mossy look to their game! <3﻿

[/size]I tried to add the german Cursor as well for my fellow germans out there. <3

[size=3][b]If you want the color of your money to match:[/b]

Download[url=https://m.blog.naver.com/khs3400/222049471897] [Stardew Valley] Font property mode[/url]  and copy and paste this in the config file for that mod:

[/size][code][size=3]{
  "Debug": false,
  "HideShadow": true,
  "EnableFixSmallFontLineSpace": false,
  "SmallFontLineSpace": 30,
  "EnableFixFontPixelZoom": false,
  "FontPixelZoom": 1.0,
  "EnableFixFontColor": false,
  "FontColor": [],
  "EnableFixImgColor": true,
  "ImgColor": [
{
"Name": "Money",
"Target": [128,0,0,255],
"Change": [56,32,78,255]
}
  ]
}
[/size][/code]
